description: Create a radiant floor heating layout in LibreCAD. 1) Draw a room boundary rectangle 3000mm x 2500mm starting at (0,0) on layer 'WALLS' (White). 2) Draw a continuous PEX tubing loop on layer 'HEATING' (Red) using a serpentine pattern. The tubing must maintain a 150mm offset from all walls and have 200mm spacing between runs. Start the loop at (150, 150), run horizontally, and end at (150, 2350). Save the file as '/home/ga/Documents/LibreCAD/radiant_heating_layout.dxf'.
